{{Top|leg}}
'''Raboa''' was a style of music. On an afternoon in [[45 ABY]], one [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after the [[Assault on Base Prime|attack]] on the installation [[Base Prime]] by the [[new Jedi Order]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] singer sang some light raboa tunes in the [[Red Ronto]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Brink Station]].<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>
 
==Behind the scenes==
Raboa appeared in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
